output.incidentTitle: Revenue Loss Incident inc-1788011898054: Beacon Failure on Roku in EU
output.postmortem: Timeline: Incident inc-1788011898054 began on 2026-08-29T13:58:10Z. An automated remediation was executed shortly after detection. Root Cause Analysis: With 95% confidence, the root cause was a failure in the beaconing stage (F07). Impression beacons were not firing for the 'roku' device class in the 'eu' region, leading to uncounted but successfully delivered ads. Evidence: The primary indicator was an impression gap of 59.1% isolated to the 'roku' device class; all other classes showed a nominal 8.5% gap. Competing hypotheses were falsified: ad fill ratio (87.5%), CDN 5xx errors (0), and stitch errors (0) were all healthy, ruling out issues with ad decisioning, delivery, or stitching. Action Taken: The 'rb-beacon-fallback' runbook was automatically executed. A configuration patch was applied to the SSAI service to switch the 'roku' device class to 'server_side' beaconing. Verification: The remediation was successful. The impression gap on the affected device class was reduced from 59.1% to a residual level of 2.9%, and the incident status is 'recovered'.
